question: The celebrated folk artist Gulabo Sapera, recipient of Padma Shri Award in 2016, is an exponent of _______ dance
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalbeliya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalbeliya dance** is a traditional folk dance of **Rajasthan**, India, performed by the Kalbeliya community.
 
• The dance form is recognized for its vibrant costumes and dynamic movements, often performed to the tunes of traditional musical instruments like the '**Pungi**' and '**Dholak**'.
 
• Kalbeliya dance is an integral part of the cultural heritage of Rajasthan and has been inscribed in the **UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity**.
 
• The dance is traditionally performed by women, with men playing the musical instruments and singing.
 
• **Gulabo Sapera **is renowned for popularizing Kalbeliya dance globally and has received numerous accolades for her contributions to the art form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gulabo Sapera, also known as Gulabo, was born in a family of snake charmers and began performing Kalbeliya dance at a very young age.
 
• She has played a significant role in bringing the dance form to the international stage, performing in various countries and cultural festivals around the world.
 
• In addition to the **Padma Shri**, she has received several other awards and recognitions for her artistic contributions.
 
• The Kalbeliya community's lifestyle and traditions are closely linked to their performances, which often depict the daily life and folklore of the community.
 
• Efforts have been made by various organizations and individuals to preserve and promote Kalbeliya dance as a vital part of India's cultural heritage.
